name: Sombras de Niterói
source:
You wake in Guanabara Bay, lost and adrift. A ghostly ferryman appears, asking for payment – not money, but a memory. In the Umbral, memories define you. Surrender one, and it's gone forever. 

To move on, you must choose: what part of yourself will you leave behind?

[From [url=https://ludomancerstudio.itch.io/sombras-de-niteroi]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在瓜纳巴拉湾醒来，迷失了方向，随波逐流。一个幽灵摆渡人出现，要求付款——不是钱，而是一段记忆。在本影中，记忆定义了你。放弃其中之一，它就永远消失了。

要继续前进，你必须选择：你将留下自己的哪一部分？

[来自[url=https://ludomancerstudio.itch.io/sombras-de-niteroi]Itch.io[/url]]
